name: Joindre Capital Services Limited
about: Joindre Capital Services Limited, together with its subsidiary, engages in the share stock broking and allied activities in India. The company offers retail investment; institutional broking, including buying and selling of stocks, securities, and derivative products; portfolio management services; derivatives, such as trading in future and options contracts; mutual funds; initial public offering services; internet trading; research services comprising intraday calls, SMS alerts, daily technical views, weekly research reports, and portfolio advice; depository services; and commodity markets. It serves retail customers, corporate clients, and mutual funds. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.
